pair.q: How do I convert {src} to {tgt} for free?
pair.a: Drop your {src} file into the workbench above or click 'Select File', confirm {tgt} as the output format, and click Convert. Download the converted {tgt} file right away with no watermarks or account requirement.

single.q: How do I convert {src} files online for free?
single.a: Add your {src} file to the workbench above, pick an output format from {count} supported formats, and click Convert. Conversions are free and carry no watermark.

pair.q: How are {src} to {tgt} files handled for privacy?

single.q: How are {src} files handled for privacy?

privacy.a: Formats the browser supports run inside your browser with WebAssembly. Anything that needs a server is sent over TLS 1.3 to an isolated worker, and the temporary output is deleted after you download it or after a short retention time.

pair.q: Does converting {src} to {tgt} preserve layout and quality?

single.q: Does {src} conversion preserve formatting and quality?

quality.a: Yes. Dedicated format engines translate vector paths, embedded fonts, tables, colour profiles, and media streams to match the source structure.

batch.q: Can I batch-convert multiple {src} files at once?
batch.a: Yes. Drop multiple files into the queue to convert them in parallel, then save each output individually or download a single consolidated ZIP archive.

install.q: Do I need to install desktop software or browser extensions?
install.a: No installation is needed. EasyConvert runs in standard web browsers across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers about format support, execution boundaries, and batch limits.
faq.paidLimits: The Pro plan raises it to {pro} and the Enterprise plan to {enterprise}.

free.a: Yes. Without an account you can run up to {dailyLimit} conversions a day on our servers, each file up to {maxSize}. Conversions that run in your browser have no daily limit.{paidLimits}

handling.q: How are my files handled during conversion?
handling.a: Image, audio, and data conversions the browser supports run in your browser's memory on your device. Formats that need native codecs or document engines are sent over TLS 1.3 to isolated workers and deleted automatically after a short retention time.

maxSize.q: What is the maximum file size limit?
maxSize.a: EasyConvert takes files of up to {maxSize} each, with or without an account.{paidLimits} Browser-executed conversions start immediately without waiting for network uploads, and a file that needs the server goes up in parts, so a large upload shows its progress and can be cancelled.

batch.q: Can I convert multiple files in one batch?
batch.a: Yes. Drop or select multiple files to queue them together, assign a shared or per-file output format, tune optional parameters, and download finished files individually or as one ZIP archive.

install.q: Do I need to install desktop software or browser plugins?
install.a: No installation is needed. EasyConvert runs in modern web browsers across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android.

advantages.sandbox: Sandboxed execution with automatic zero-retention cleanup
advantages.container: Preserves container layout, streams, and metadata

formatSelector.noTargets: No supported output formats for this file.

pdf.desc: PDF is an open ISO standard format for electronic document exchange. It encapsulates formatted text, vector graphics, raster images, and embedded fonts independent of operating system or viewer hardware.
pdf.adv1: Preserves vector typography, pagination, and visual layout
pdf.adv3: Supports digital signatures, interactive forms, and metadata

docx.desc: DOCX is an XML-based document container used by Microsoft Word. It packages formatted text, tables, charts, embedded media, and styles inside a compressed ZIP archive.
docx.adv1: Editable typography, headers, footers, and tables
docx.adv2: Compact XML compression structure with broad interoperability
docx.adv3: Native compatibility across desktop and mobile word processors

doc.desc: DOC is a binary document format developed by Microsoft for Word 97 through 2003. It stores styled text, inline graphics, tables, and formatting inside an OLE compound file container.
doc.adv1: Compatibility across legacy word processing workflows
doc.adv2: Supports embedded OLE objects, drawing shapes, and font metrics
doc.adv3: Direct migration source for modern open standards such as DOCX and PDF

csv.desc: CSV stores two-dimensional tabular records as plain UTF-8 text lines with delimiter-separated fields and RFC 4180 quoting rules.
csv.adv1: Plain-text tabular layout readable in any editor or script
csv.adv2: Direct import and export across SQL databases, spreadsheets, and dataframe tools
csv.adv3: Low byte overhead well suited for streaming line-by-line parsers

json.desc: JSON is a text data-interchange format encoding key-value objects, arrays, numbers, booleans, and UTF-8 strings per RFC 8259 and ECMA-404.
json.adv1: Primary wire format for HTTP APIs and configuration schemas
json.adv2: Built-in parsers across JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust

xlsx.desc: XLSX packages multi-sheet workbooks, typed cell values, shared string tables, formulas, and number formats inside a ZIP-compressed OpenXML archive.
xlsx.adv1: Supports up to 1,048,576 rows and 16,384 columns per worksheet
xlsx.adv2: Multi-sheet workbooks with typed cells, formulas, and number formatting
xlsx.adv3: Standard workbook interchange format across spreadsheet suites

xls.desc: XLS is the BIFF8 binary workbook format used by Excel 97 through 2003, storing worksheets, cell records, and formulas in a Compound File Binary stream.
xls.adv1: Interoperates with legacy accounting and reporting exports
xls.adv2: Converts cleanly to XLSX, CSV, JSON, and PDF
xls.adv3: Retains cell types, worksheet names, and numeric formatting

pptx.desc: PPTX stores presentation slides, master layouts, DrawingML vector shapes, embedded images, and speaker notes inside an OpenXML ZIP package.
pptx.adv1: Structured slide masters, vector shapes, and embedded media assets
pptx.adv2: Clean XML part layout for slide rendering and PDF export
pptx.adv3: Supported across desktop, web, and mobile presentation tools

mp4.desc: MP4 is a digital multimedia container used to store video, audio, and subtitle streams. Derived from the ISO Base Media File Format, it combines high compression efficiency with native browser and hardware playback.
mp4.adv1: Playback support across modern devices, TVs, and web browsers
mp4.adv2: High compression efficiency preserving resolution and colour fidelity
mp4.adv3: Supports progressive streaming and fast-start web playback

mp3.desc: MP3 is a lossy digital audio compression format. Psychoacoustic perceptual coding attenuates masked frequency components to reduce file size while retaining clear audio playback.
mp3.adv1: Compact file size at roughly 10% of uncompressed PCM audio
mp3.adv2: Native playback across digital audio players and web browsers
mp3.adv3: Low bandwidth footprint suited for streaming and portable storage

wav.desc: WAV is an uncompressed audio container storing linear pulse-code modulation (LPCM) samples. It records acoustic waveforms sample-for-sample without lossy compression artifacts.
wav.adv1: Uncompressed PCM audio fidelity without encoding artifacts
wav.adv2: Minimal decoding overhead for low-latency audio editing
wav.adv3: Standard master exchange format for studio production and mastering

aac.desc: AAC is a perceptual audio coding standard designed as the successor to MP3. At matching bitrates, AAC delivers cleaner high-frequency detail across stereo and multichannel layouts.
aac.adv1: Higher coding efficiency than MP3 at matching bitrates
aac.adv2: Default audio codec across MP4 streaming and mobile platforms
aac.adv3: Supports up to 48 full-bandwidth channels and high sample rates

flac.desc: FLAC is an open, royalty-free lossless audio codec. Compressed FLAC streams decode back to an exact bit-for-bit match of the source PCM audio.
flac.adv1: Bit-exact audio reconstruction with 30 to 50% size reduction
flac.adv2: Open-source, royalty-free specification with embedded CRC checksums
flac.adv3: Supports sample depths up to 32 bits and sample rates up to 655 kHz

ogg.desc: OGG is an open multimedia bitstream container commonly paired with the Vorbis or Opus audio codecs for patent-free streaming and game asset delivery.
ogg.adv1: Open-source and patent-free container and codec standard
ogg.adv2: Variable bitrate encoding with low framing overhead
ogg.adv3: Broad support in game engines and desktop web browsers

m4a.desc: M4A is an audio-only MPEG-4 container carrying AAC or Apple Lossless (ALAC) streams alongside structured chapter and cover-art metadata.
m4a.adv1: Compact AAC or lossless ALAC audio inside an ISO MP4 container
m4a.adv2: Native playback and metadata tagging on macOS, iOS, and web browsers
m4a.adv3: Supports chapter markers, cover art, and gapless playback

png.desc: PNG is a raster graphics file format using lossless DEFLATE compression. It supports indexed palettes, greyscale, and full RGBA alpha transparency up to 16 bits per channel.
png.adv1: Lossless compression with zero generation loss across repeated saves
png.adv3: Preferred raster format for UI graphics, diagrams, logos, and screenshots

jpg.desc: JPG is the ISO standard for continuous-tone photographic images, applying Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) compression tuned for natural colour gradients.
jpg.adv1: Adjustable quality factor balancing visual detail and byte size
jpg.adv2: Native support across every web browser, operating system, and camera
jpg.adv3: Small payload size for web publishing and messaging

jpeg.desc: JPEG is the standard continuous-tone photographic format identical in bitstream structure to JPG, using DCT block compression for natural imagery.
jpeg.adv1: Universal hardware and software decoding support
jpeg.adv2: Configurable chroma subsampling and quantization quality
jpeg.adv3: Default output format across digital cameras and scanners

webp.desc: WebP provides both lossy VP8 intra-frame coding and lossless dictionary compression for web imagery, supporting alpha transparency, ICC profiles, and animation.
webp.adv1: 26% smaller lossless payloads than PNG with full alpha transparency
webp.adv2: 25 to 34% smaller lossy files than JPEG at equivalent SSIM
webp.adv3: Supports multi-frame animation, ICC colour profiles, and EXIF/XMP metadata

avif.desc: AVIF stores AV1 intra-coded still images inside an ISO HEIF container, supporting 8-bit, 10-bit, and 12-bit colour depths alongside HDR transfer functions.
avif.adv1: Up to 50% smaller byte size than JPEG at matching perceptual quality
avif.adv2: Supports High Dynamic Range (PQ / HLG) and wide colour gamuts
avif.adv3: Decoded natively by current desktop and mobile browsers

heic.desc: HEIC stores HEVC (H.265) intra-coded photographs inside an ISO Base Media container, cutting storage size roughly in half relative to baseline JPEG.
heic.adv1: Roughly half the byte size of equivalent JPEG photographs
heic.adv2: Stores 10-bit colour, auxiliary depth maps, and burst sequences
heic.adv3: Default camera capture container on iOS and iPadOS devices

svg.desc: SVG is an XML vector graphics specification describing two-dimensional paths, shapes, text, and gradients mathematically so artwork renders sharply at any DPI.
svg.adv1: Resolution-independent scaling from small UI icons to print layouts
svg.adv2: Compact text-based XML structure that compresses well with GZIP or Brotli
svg.adv3: Directly scriptable and styleable with CSS in web documents

gif.desc: GIF is an indexed-palette bitmap format using lossless LZW compression for up to 256 colours per frame and looping frame sequences.
gif.adv1: Autoplay looping animation support across browsers and chat clients
gif.adv2: 1-bit index transparency and frame disposal timing control
gif.adv3: Convenient target for short screen-capture clips

epub.desc: EPUB packages XHTML content documents, CSS stylesheets, fonts, and navigation manifests in a ZIP container for reflowable digital books.
epub.adv1: Reflowable typography that adapts to screen width and reader font settings
epub.adv2: Open W3C publishing standard supported across dedicated e-readers
epub.adv3: Structured table of contents, landmarks, and OPF publication metadata

mobi.desc: MOBI is a binary PalmDOC-derived e-book container developed by Mobipocket for portable e-ink readers, bundling HTML markup, images, and chapter offsets.
mobi.adv1: Compatible with older Kindle e-ink hardware and desktop reader apps
mobi.adv2: Compact PalmDOC or Huff/CDIC compressed text records
mobi.adv3: Supports embedded chapter navigation and dictionary lookup tables

zip.desc: ZIP bundles one or more files and directory trees with independent per-entry DEFLATE compression and a central directory index.
zip.adv1: Built-in extraction on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android
zip.adv2: Random-access central directory allows extracting single entries quickly
zip.adv3: CRC-32 integrity checksums for every archived entry

rar.desc: RAR is a compressed archive container supporting solid dictionary compression, Reed-Solomon recovery records, and multi-volume split archives.
rar.adv1: Optional recovery records for reconstructing damaged archive sectors
rar.adv2: Multi-volume splitting and solid compression across similar files
rar.adv3: AES-256 payload and filename encryption support

7z.desc: 7Z is an open modular archive container using LZMA and LZMA2 dictionary compression with large solid blocks and optional AES-256 encryption.
7z.adv1: High LZMA and LZMA2 compression ratios on large file sets
7z.adv2: Solid block compression reduces redundancy across related files
7z.adv3: AES-256 payload and header encryption support

tar.desc: TAR serializes files and directory hierarchies sequentially in 512-byte blocks while preserving POSIX permissions, ownership, and modification timestamps.
tar.adv1: Preserves POSIX permissions, timestamps, and directory structure
tar.adv2: Standard source distribution container across Unix and Linux toolchains
tar.adv3: Pairs cleanly with GZIP, BZip2, XZ, or Zstandard stream compressors

dxf.desc: DXF is a tagged CAD data exchange format representing 2D and 3D entities, layers, blocks, arcs, polylines, and splines for CAD/CAM interoperability.
dxf.adv1: Vector CAD exchange format supported across drafting and CAM software
dxf.adv2: Preserves named layers, coordinate geometry, arcs, and spline entities
dxf.adv3: Common input format for laser cutting, plotting, and CNC workflows

ttf.desc: TTF defines quadratic Bézier glyph outlines, character-to-glyph cmap tables, kerning metrics, and hinting instructions in a single binary font file.
ttf.adv1: Sharp outline glyph rendering across desktop and mobile displays
ttf.adv2: Grid-fitting hinting tables keep small body text legible
ttf.adv3: Installed natively on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android

woff2.desc: WOFF2 wraps TrueType or OpenType glyph tables with font-specific preprocessing and Brotli compression for `@font-face` delivery on the web.
woff2.adv1: Brotli-compressed font payloads roughly 30% smaller than WOFF 1.0
woff2.adv2: Faster webfont network transfer reduces layout shift during page load
woff2.adv3: Supported natively across all evergreen desktop and mobile browsers

security.heading: Security & Data Handling
security.intro: Built around isolated execution and short-lived storage boundaries.

tls.heading: TLS 1.3 Transport Encryption
tls.body: Uploads, signed storage transfers, and result downloads run strictly over encrypted HTTPS channels.

sandbox.heading: Sandboxed Browser & Worker Execution
sandbox.body: Supported pairs run locally in browser memory, while complex formats execute inside isolated worker sandboxes.

cleanup.heading: Automatic File Cleanup
cleanup.body: Temporary job inputs and converted outputs expire automatically after short retention windows.

api.heading: REST API & Batch Workflows
api.intro: Automate single-file conversions via POST /api/v1/convert or submit multi-step DAG pipelines to POST /api/v1/jobs with signed webhook delivery.

howItWorks.heading: How Conversion Works
howItWorks.intro: Three direct steps without account walls or watermarks.

add.heading: 1. Add source files
add.body: Select files from your device, drag them onto the workbench, paste from clipboard, or import from a public link.

pick.heading: 2. Pick format & options
pick.body: Choose any compatible target extension and optionally tune codecs, dimensions, page ranges, or delimiters.

download.heading: 3. Convert & download
download.body: Download converted files individually as soon as they finish, or bundle multi-file batches into one ZIP archive.

retention.heading: Zero Permanent Retention
retention.body: EasyConvert processes supported client-side conversions directly in your browser memory without uploading source files to external storage.

isolation.heading: Isolated Workers & Automatic Cleanup
isolation.body: When a format pair needs server processing, or you use the REST API, requests travel over TLS 1.3 to isolated, temporary worker containers. Output files are deleted after you download them or after a short retention time.

noResale.heading: No Content Resale or Inspection
noResale.body: We do not sell, rent, or train models on your files. Uploaded bytes exist only to complete the conversion you requested.

acceptance.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using EasyConvert, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, discontinue use of the service.

acceptableUse.heading: 2. Acceptable Use
acceptableUse.body: You agree not to convert content that you lack permission to process, and not to submit malicious binaries, exploit payloads, or unlawful material.

availability.heading: 3. Service Availability & Free Use
availability.body: EasyConvert is free to use in the web application. Conversions that run in your browser have no daily limit, and conversions that run on our servers are free for up to {dailyLimit} a day without an account. No subscription, credit pack, or paid account is required.

purpose.heading: Purpose-Built File Conversion Utility
purpose.body: EasyConvert provides fast, accurate file conversions across {count} registered formats spanning documents, spreadsheets, presentations, raster and RAW images, vector graphics, CAD drawings, audio, video, fonts, ebooks, and archives.

architecture.heading: Hybrid Browser & Ephemeral Sandbox Architecture
architecture.body: Formats the browser supports run on your device through WebAssembly and WebCodecs. Heavy or specialized formats run in isolated workers over TLS 1.3 and are deleted automatically after a short retention time.

transport.heading: TLS 1.3 Transport Encryption
transport.body: All HTTPS traffic uses TLS 1.3 with strict HSTS headers, CSRF validation on cookie-authenticated routes, and scoped bearer keys for programmatic API calls across {count} supported formats.

isolation.heading: Sandboxed Browser & Worker Isolation
isolation.body: Browser conversions stay inside the browser's origin sandbox. Server conversions run in resource-limited worker processes with strict input validation, archive decompression limits, and automatic deletion of output files.

conformance.heading: Conformance Target
conformance.body: EasyConvert targets Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA conformance across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports in both light and dark themes.

keyboard.heading: Keyboard Navigation & Shortcuts
keyboard.body: Every interactive control is operable with a keyboard alone. A skip link jumps directly to #main-content, focus indicators remain visible on all interactive elements, format selectors and tabs support arrow and tab key navigation, and modal dialogs use native HTML '<'dialog> focus containment with Escape dismissal.

landmarks.heading: Screen Reader Landmarks & Live Announcements
landmarks.body: Pages expose semantic '<'header>, '<'nav>, '<'main>, and '<'footer> landmarks, sequential heading levels from h1 through h3, explicit '<'label htmlFor> associations on every text input and selector, descriptive aria-label names on icon-only controls, and polite status regions for conversion progress and clipboard confirmation.

contrast.heading: Visual Contrast, Motion & Zoom
contrast.body: Text keeps at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio and the borders of text fields keep at least 3:1 across light and dark palettes, and buttons are identified by their labels rather than by their outlines. Form controls use a minimum 16px text size to prevent forced viewport zoom on mobile browsers, primary and icon buttons provide 44px touch targets, layouts reflow cleanly at 390px width and 200% browser zoom without horizontal page scroll, and non-essential motion honours prefers-reduced-motion.

feedback.heading: Feedback & Assistance
feedback.body: If you encounter an accessibility barrier on any EasyConvert page or API tool, contact our team so we can reproduce and resolve the issue promptly.

contact.heading: Get in Touch
contact.intro: Send questions about format support, conversion fidelity, or API integration directly to our engineering team.

email.heading: Direct Support Email
email.body: Contact our engineering team for technical questions, API inquiries, or general feedback.

bugs.heading: Bug Reports & Issues
bugs.body: Found an edge case or rendering discrepancy? Email reproduction steps and a non-sensitive sample file.

problems.bad-request: The request could not be read. Check the values and try again.
problems.forbidden: This action is not allowed for your account.
problems.method-not-allowed: This request cannot be sent this way.
problems.payload-too-large: The file is larger than this request can take.
problems.length-required: The upload did not report its size. Try again.
problems.unsupported-media-type: This file type cannot be sent here.
problems.rate-limited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
problems.concurrency-limit: Too many conversions are running at once. Try again when one finishes.
problems.quota-exceeded: You have used today's conversion limit. Try again tomorrow.
problems.upload-budget-exceeded: You have used today's limit for uploads and link imports. Try again tomorrow.
problems.storage-full: Storage is full right now. Try again later.
problems.service-unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
problems.internal-server-error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
problems.unprocessable-entity: This file cannot be converted with these settings.
problems.engine-unavailable: The program this conversion needs is not available right now. Try again later.
problems.job-timeout: The conversion did not finish in time. Try again.
problems.client-closed-request: The conversion stopped because the connection closed. Try again.
problems.pdf-postprocess-failed: The document converted, but the PDF step you chose could not be applied to it.
problems.pdfa-validation-failed: The PDF could not be made to meet the PDF/A profile you chose.
problems.option-not-supported: One of the chosen settings does not apply to this conversion.
problems.unknown-format: The format of this file could not be recognized.
problems.invalid-archive: The archive is damaged or in a form that cannot be read.
problems.missing-archive-volume: A part of this multi-part archive is missing. Add every part.
problems.archive-encrypted-header: The archive is protected with a password, so its contents cannot be listed.
problems.job-state-corrupt: The conversion record could not be read. Start the conversion again.
problems.part-in-flight: A part of this upload is still being received. Try again in a moment.
problems.idempotency-key-reused: This is the same request with different contents. Start again.
problems.idempotency-key-in-flight: The same request is still being processed. Try again in a moment.
problems.client-ip-trust-unconfigured: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
problems.byos-invalid-endpoint: The storage endpoint cannot be used. Check its address and try again.

problems.graph-without-conversion: A job needs at least one conversion. Add a conversion step between the import and the export.

limits.quota-exceeded: You have used today's limit of {limit} conversions. Try again tomorrow.

limits.imports-larger-than-left: This file is larger than the {limit} left today for link imports. Try again tomorrow.

conversion.multipart_required: The file was not sent in a form the converter can read. Reload the page and try again.
conversion.target_required: Choose a format to convert to.

conversion.invalid_options: The conversion settings could not be read. Reset them and try again.
conversion.spoofed_file: The file's content does not match its extension. Check that the file is what its name says.

conversion.timeout: The conversion did not finish in time. Try again.
conversion.engine_unavailable: The program this conversion needs is not available right now. Try again later.

queue.conversionFailed: Conversion failed. Try another format or try again.

queue.clientEdgeFailed: The browser could not convert this file. It stays on your device, because it is set to convert in the browser only.

queue.edgeFailedFirst: The browser tried first and could not convert it.
queue.zipFailed: Could not build the ZIP archive.
